steps.en: Run the installer for your operating system
steps.zh: 运行对应操作系统的安装脚本

steps.en: Starts the service and local Web console
steps.zh: 启动服务与本地 Web console

steps.en: Choose a model, channel, permissions, and skills
steps.zh: 选择模型、通道、权限与 skill

steps.en: Routes each message through planning, tools, memory, and knowledge
steps.zh: 把消息交给规划、工具、记忆与知识库

steps.en: Returns the completed result through the originating channel
steps.zh: 从原通道发回完成结果

value.en: One configured agent can act, remember, and reply across your chosen channels without custom glue for each turn.
value.zh: 一个配置好的 Agent 能在所选通道行动、记忆并回复，不必为每轮任务重写胶水。
